title: Bounded Twin-Width Tournaments are $\dchi$-Bounded
summary: For a tournament $T$ and a vertex ordering $\prec$, let $T^{\prec}$ be the graph of backward arcs in $\prec$. The diclique number of a tournament is $\domega(T)=\min_{\prec}ω(T^{\prec})$, and the dichromatic number is $\dchi(T)=\min_{\prec}χ(T^{\prec})$. We prove a mixed parameter transfer theorem: for all $k$ and $r$, if $\tww(T)\le k$ and $ω(T^{\prec})\le r$, then the ordered twin-width of $(T^{\prec},\prec)$ is bounded by a function of $k$ and $r$.
